structured.answer: I won't decide anything from this page. Harel's tracks all charge about half a percent of the savings a year, and most of them are in shares. The only quiet-looking one, "כספי (שקלי)", made about 4.25–4.4% over 3 years, but I'm not sure what it is. I'll ask you or the bank before I move anything.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the product buttons (קופת גמל להשקעה, קרן השתלמות, קרנות סל…)
stuck.why: There are 105 products and none of them is a deposit, so I didn't know which one was for me.

stuck.where: The return column showing 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number
stuck.why: I couldn't tell if this meant no return, a loss, or that there's no data yet.

stuck.where: אשראי ואג"ח: 5.28% for 3 years but 2.38% for 5 years
stuck.why: I didn't understand why the longer period would be lower.
Too many numbers, the same track names repeated under different products, and a dark screen. I got tired and anxious and stopped after screen 5.

used: The heading 'הראל' and the line saying the fees are what was actually charged in 2025
The return column for 'כספי (שקלי)' (4.25%, 4.4%) and 'אג"ח סחיר'
The 'מניות' share percentages, which I used to stay away from the tracks with high returns
skimmed: The group header lines with fee ranges
The rows under תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים
skipped: The ? icons and the sorting arrows
The top menu (מדריך, השוואה למטרה, השקעה במדד)
unsure_meaning: פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים
עוד לא דווח with an orange sign
not_found: Anything called a deposit (פיקדון) or something that says it's safe and guaranteed
A plain sentence telling me which track is low-risk
A comparison with what my bank gives on a deposit
What the fee comes to in shekels

findings.what: Very busy table with three or four numbers in every row. It made me anxious and tired me quickly.
Dark background with small grey text; the column headings and the lines under them were hard to read even enlarged.
findings.where: Table header and the sub-lines on screen 1

findings.what: 'פחות מ־3 שנים' where a return should be. It isn't clear whether that's bad or just missing.
English letters and jargon (S&P 500, מט"ח, עוקב מדד, קרנות סל) with no explanation in words
Nothing says which tracks are safe like a deposit
The same track names repeat under every product, so I couldn't tell the difference between them
The biggest numbers (21.37%, 13.7%) stick in my head, but they belong to tracks that are almost all shares
findings.where: גמל מסלול מניות, עוקב מדד S&P 500
